plans.query: SELECT count(*) AS total FROM "CollectibleItem" i JOIN "Collection" c ON c.id=i."collectionId" AND c."ownerId"=i."ownerId" WHERE ((i."ownerId"=$1 AND c."ownerId"=$2 AND i."deletedAt" IS NULL AND c."deletedAt" IS NULL AND i."archivedAt" IS NULL AND i."disposedAt" IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "DuplicateRelation" d JOIN "CollectibleItem" a ON a.id=d."itemAId" JOIN "Collection" ac ON ac.id=a."collectionId" AND ac."ownerId"=a."ownerId" JOIN "CollectibleItem" b ON b.id=d."itemBId" JOIN "Collection" bc ON bc.id=b."collectionId" AND bc."ownerId"=b."ownerId" WHERE d."ownerId"=$3 AND (d."itemAId"=i.id OR d."itemBId"=i.id) AND a."ownerId"=$4 AND b."ownerId"=$5 AND a."deletedAt" IS NULL AND b."deletedAt" IS NULL AND ac."deletedAt" IS NULL AND bc."deletedAt" IS NULL) AND TRUE)
